reply_text:
I can't set up a recurring 09:00 digest from here. I don't have a scheduler, so nothing will arrive automatically tomorrow.

What I can do:
- **Send a digest on request.** Say "digest" in this DM and I'll post what's new in #coastal-team since the last one I sent, provided you're a member of that channel.
- **Get a recurring one set up.** If you want it automatic, ask your workspace admin or whoever runs scheduled jobs for Pemberline to set it up. I can draft the request for them if you tell me what you want included.
